## PR Type:
Enhancement

___
## PR Description:
- Introduced new file handling capabilities, including file upload, download, and content retrieval.
- Implemented streaming processing via Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time updates.
- Enhanced server processing with new endpoints for YAML file operations.
- Improved CORS handling with detailed logging and configuration options.
- Added comprehensive tests for new server functionalities, including file operations and streaming.
- Updated the server to support advanced Google models.

___
## PR Main Files Walkthrough:
<details> <summary>files:</summary>

- `utils/server/file_handlers.go`: Added new functions for handling file content retrieval, file uploads, YAML uploads, and YAML processing. Enhanced existing file handling logic to support POST methods for YAML files.
- `utils/server/handlers.go`: Enhanced the handleProcess function to support streaming via SSE. Added detailed error handling and logging for various scenarios, including invalid requests and path validation.
- `utils/server/handlers_test.go`: Introduced new tests for streaming processing and YAML handling. Added mock providers and custom response recorders to simulate server behavior and validate responses.
- `utils/server/server.go`: Improved path validation logic with detailed debugging information. Enhanced CORS handling with additional configuration options and logging. Added new routes for file and YAML operations.
- `utils/server/types.go`: Added new types for handling file upload responses and YAML requests. Introduced custom response writers to support SSE and capture status codes.
- `utils/server/provider_handlers_test.go`: Added tests for provider route handling, including deletion and unauthorized access scenarios. Validated server behavior with different HTTP methods and path parameters.
- `utils/server/file_download_test.go`: Implemented tests for file download functionality, covering various scenarios such as valid downloads, path traversal attempts, and directory download attempts.
- `utils/server/file_upload_test.go`: Developed tests for file upload functionality, including valid uploads, path traversal attempts, and missing file scenarios. Verified file existence and content post-upload.
- `utils/models/ollama.go`: Refined model support logic for the Ollama provider with detailed debugging information. Enhanced error handling for API requests and responses.
- `utils/server/provider_handlers.go`: Modified provider deletion logic to handle path parameters and save updated configurations. Improved error handling and response messaging.
</details>

___
## User Description:
- Added new Google models
- Added a new test to check for congruity between models available for processing and configuration
- Extended server functionality, including enhanced CORS
- Streaming processing via SSE over the API
- Server file operations for upload / download of YAML and input/output files
- Updated the server openapi spec doc and postman collection
- More server tests for the new file and streaming capabilities

author: waltsims
body:
This pull request introduces several changes to the `kwave` utilities, focusing on handling deprecation warnings, improving affine transformations, and updating rotation matrix calculations. The most important changes include adding a deprecation utility, replacing `get_affine_matrix` with `make_affine`, and using `scipy.spatial.transform.Rotation` for rotation matrices.

### Deprecation Handling:
* Added a `deprecated` decorator in `kwave/utils/deprecation.py` to mark functions as deprecated and provide warnings.

### Affine Transformations:
* Replaced `get_affine_matrix` with `make_affine` in `kwave/utils/kwave_array.py` and `kwave/utils/math.py` to create affine transformation matrices. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-6c919b1bd4c514a3c816c149174528774b4fc1558ee983ab43d5f7add8a12c21L683-R690) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-63cb2fd7dc10cec621481625a6e3b12dab9566c98b152dbee6044fa9701072a6L309-R386)
* Deprecated `get_affine_matrix` in favor of `make_affine`.

### Rotation Matrices:
* Updated rotation matrix calculations to use `scipy.spatial.transform.Rotation` in `kwave/utils/mapgen.py` and `kwave/utils/math.py`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-287c99b222c6995856cb70faddfbff536a293ff0c6edaf623e8784323deaf2d7L2628-R2630) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-63cb2fd7dc10cec621481625a6e3b12dab9566c98b152dbee6044fa9701072a6R5-R52) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-63cb2fd7dc10cec621481625a6e3b12dab9566c98b152dbee6044fa9701072a6L309-R386)

### Code Refactor:
* Removed unused imports and reorganized imports in `kwave/utils/kwave_array.py` and `kwave/utils/mapgen.py`. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-6c919b1bd4c514a3c816c149174528774b4fc1558ee983ab43d5f7add8a12c21L16-R18) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-287c99b222c6995856cb70faddfbff536a293ff0c6edaf623e8784323deaf2d7R13-R17)

author: yuzefovich
body:
Previously, we would hit an assertion error when trying to use an unimplemented builtin in the CREATE VIEW statement and this is now fixed. The issue is that we resolve unimplemented builtins as a definition with zero overloads, and all places that previously assumed at least one existing overload have been audited. The resolved function definition has been updated to have "unsupported with issue" integer indicating why there are no overloads.

Additionally, `UnsupportedWithIssue` property is now changed to be `uint` since we didn't use "negative value as having no corresponding issue" ability.

I decided to not include a release note since this seems like an edge case and we've only seen this a handful of times in sentry.

Fixes: #128535.

Release note: None
